title: Visionary Temple
arrangement: A single deterministic 60 BPM psybient journey aligned to the sixteen-second breath: tanpura-like drone, sub-bass heartbeat, breath-shaped sixteenth-note plucked arpeggios, glass shimmer and wordless formant pads, moving through four harmonic passages that mirror the tunnel.

sources.origin: Authored deterministic synthesis, no sampled or generated backing recording
